kebab_example: aliyun smartag create-smart-access-gateway-client-user --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-gnhe6sywtare50000 --user-mail username@example.com --bandwidth 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSmartAccessGatewayClientUser

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) app instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关App实例所在地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG app instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en:
The username of the client account. The usernames of client accounts added to the same SAG app instance must be unique.

The username must be 7 to 33 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a digit.

For a client account, if you specify the username, you must also specify the password. If you specify the password, you must specify the username
parameters.help_zh:
用户名，同一个智能接入网关App实例下的用户名不可以重复。
名称长度为7~33个字符，必须以大小写字母或数字开头，可以包含下划线（_） 、at（@）、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）。

用户名和密码相互依赖，若指定用户名则必须指定密码，反之，若指定密码则必须指定用户名
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
If you enable the client app service, you must set the IP address of the client app. The current client account uses the specified IP address to connect to Alibaba Cloud.

The IP address must fall within a private CIDR block.

If you disable the client app service, an IP address within a private CIDR block is assigned to the client account. Each connection to Alibaba Cloud uses a different IP address
parameters.help_zh:
如果开启客户端App服务，需要设置App的IP地址。当前账号始终保持以选择的IP地址接入。

设置App的IP地址必须在私网网段内。

如果关闭客户端App服务，系统自动从私网网段内分配可用IP地址，每次重连IP地址都会重新分配
parameters.name: client_ip

parameters.help_en: The email address of the client account. The username and password are sent to the specified email address by the administrator
parameters.help_zh: 普通用户的邮箱地址，用于管理员向普通用户发送登录App的账号信息
parameters.name: user_mail

parameters.help_en: The maximum bandwidth value. Unit: Kbit/s. Valid values: 1 to 20000. Default value: 2000
parameters.help_zh: 带宽峰值。单位：Kbps。取值范围：1 Kbps~20000 Kbps。默认值：2000 Kbps
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The password that is used to log on to the SAG app.

The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), at signs (@), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a digit
parameters.help_zh:
登录智能接入网关App的密码。

密码命名规则： 8~32位字符，以（A-Za-z0-9）开头，可包含数字、英文大小写、下划线（_）、at（@）、短划线（-）
parameters.name: password

Bandwidth.description_en: The maximum bandwidth value. Unit: Kbit/s

ClientIp.description_en: The IP address of the client app

UserMail.description_en: The email address of the client account
